messages.content: I’m ready to book the Washington trip. Please verify the 5:05 Wednesday flight, the 7:25 Thursday return, and the Capitol Hill Hotel terms before I enter payment.

The selected round trip is still listed as nonstop DFW–DCA: Wednesday, December 3, departing at 5:05 p.m. and arriving at 8:58 p.m.; Thursday, December 4, departing at 7:25 p.m. and arriving at 10:02 p.m. The fare is $498 round trip, including taxes. It is standard economy, allows one carry-on and one personal item, and is nonrefundable. Changes are permitted without a change fee, but any fare difference applies. Checked bags and advance seat selection cost extra.
Good. Is that one ticket, and are both flights confirmed at that price rather than separate one-way estimates?
Yes. The $498 is the current total for one passenger on a single round-trip reservation covering both nonstop flights. The quoted total does not include a checked bag or paid seat assignment.
Now check the hotel. My flight lands close to 9:00, so I need to know they won’t treat that as a missed arrival. Also confirm there is no destination or facility fee.

The refundable one-night rate at Capitol Hill Hotel is $277 including taxes. The property permits evening arrival and has a staffed front desk; add your flight details and an estimated arrival of about 10:00 p.m. to the reservation. The rate shows no destination, resort, or facility charge. A card is required to guarantee the room, and incidentals may be authorized separately at check-in.
What is the cancellation cutoff, and does the total still come to $775?

Cancellation is free until 6:00 p.m. Eastern on Tuesday, December 2. After that, the penalty is the first night plus tax. Yes: $498 airfare plus $277 hotel equals $775 for the complete flight-and-hotel total.
Put the booking details in the order I’ll need them and flag anything I should read on the payment screens.

Book the round trip first: DFW to DCA on December 3 at 5:05 p.m., returning DCA to DFW on December 4 at 7:25 p.m., one traveler, $498 total. Confirm both segments remain nonstop and that the final page still says standard economy, nonrefundable, with changes subject only to fare difference. Decline any bag or seat add-ons you do not need. Then reserve Capitol Hill Hotel for one adult, check-in December 3 and check-out December 4, refundable rate, $277 tax-inclusive. Enter an arrival note of approximately 10:00 p.m. with the inbound flight details. Before submitting, verify the December 2 cancellation deadline, a zero destination/facility-fee line, and that no optional package has been added. Expected combined charge: $775.
